status_note: Dimensionless candidate only. Physical levels are unresolved, the design is not preregistered, and no run is released.

x.caution: numeric coding imposes an interpolation model over these counts; categorical coding would require redoing rank, aliases and holdouts

z.maps: registered radial step magnitude s, s >= 0

derived: each equal-width seam has w = 2*pi*F/n radians; a physical width g must name its radius and convention
constraints: positive rotor-envelope clearance with registered margin
holdout_note: Reserved: never used to choose terms or fit coefficients. They lie inside the convex hull of the training locations, so they test new combinations and intermediate levels, not an unseen defect family, a new seam count, a new rotor scale or a new specimen.
controls_note: Experimental roles differ. If the continuous and sealed segmented CFD geometry are identical, deduplicate the solve by geometry and input identity while keeping both experimental control definitions.
run_accounting: 13 training + 4 holdout + 3 control = 20 planned condition labels, before operating points, mesh levels, model variants, phase positions or thrust iterations. This is not a promise of 20 solves. Reinstallation is physical replication; another deterministic solve of the same case is not.
limits: The ten declared columns are identifiable; that does not make omitted effects absent.
x^3 = x, y^3 = y and z^3 = z at the three training levels, so pure cubic effects alias with linear effects.
x*y*z = 0 at every training location, so a three-way interaction is invisible there. It is -0.25 and +0.25 at H03 and H04.
The all-extreme corners lie outside the training convex hull; do not claim behaviour there.
Seam count, individual width and total opening are exactly related geometrically and must never be supplied as independent factors.
Three residual degrees of freedom belong to the fitted deterministic surrogate. They are not pure error and not physical replication.
